title: Add dated attendance sessions, server locks, audit and enrollment cancellation
dod: Existing phase-one types and repository APIs remain backward compatible; new session/attendance/enrollment APIs follow the agreed contract.

Additive reviewed migration implements immutable per-date schedule and roster snapshots, boolean presence defaulting false, completion, substitute additions and cancellation without destroying history.

Server-authoritative Europe/Belgrade start time prevents presence changes, substitute additions and roll-call completion before the session begins. Past sessions remain editable; cancelled sessions reject attendance mutations.
Creator/editor identities and timestamps are set by trusted database logic from the authenticated user, not accepted as client authorization or audit claims.

Enrollment cancellation uses cancelled_at and preserves historical enrollment. Explicit APP-S2 cancellation behavior is additive approved work; D1 remains unchanged in identity and exhausted retry accounting.
All new exposed tables and RPCs enforce active-trainer authorization, reject anonymous/non-trainer access and prevent audit/self-authorization bypasses.
npm run typecheck, npm run lint and npm run build pass; document exact RPC parameters, server rules, migration and rollback-test procedure.
No worker remote migration application, account creation, emails, secret/environment edits, Git mutation, commit, push or deployment.
qaFinding: Raphael confirmed pre-start session materialization and device-local business date bugs in final A2 initial source
